note_one: upper-one-r1 (upper-one-20261117): one steering law after the dashed TURN hand-over (replaces ALIGN / FOLLOW / HOLD; needs the candidate upper_single.py). u = centre + I + clamp(k_psi*(phi - tgt), lim_psi) + clamp(k_r*gz, lim_r); phi = yaw - deck direction (edge estimator D, starts at h); tgt = clamp(k_y*(X - xref)*w, tgt_lim) from the edge estimator lateral X (low-passed lat_tau_s, rate lat_rate_cm_s). Gains: model margins PM >= 52 deg / GM >= 2.1 over 0.55-0.95 m/s, K 0.208-0.27, delay 0.164-0.204 s (today FOLLOW / HOLD GM 1.1-1.3 at 0.75 m/s, < 1 at 0.95). Remove "one" or set enabled false = today.
